caption: The drawing features the head of a mythical or fantastical creature, resembling a dragon or sea serpent, depicted in profile facing right. The head is elongated with a prominent snout and an open mouth displaying a long, curved tongue that extends outward and curves upward. The creature has a rounded nose with small, dotted nostrils, and a visible circular eye. The top and sides of the head are adorned with layered, pointed scales or ridges colored in shades of brown and muted yellow, with darker accents along the lines and tips. The lower jaw and the back of the creature’s neck display scales or textured patterns primarily in brown with hints of ochre and yellow. The inside of the mouth and tongue are shaded with reddish and brown hues. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional elements or objects present in the composition.
title: Animal Head
